milestone: E1 — Execution guidance: the selected action becomes a driven, dated, single-next-step plan

what_is_proven.read_composition_before: Untouched deal composes a coherent guide from REAL production data: single next step with hard numbers (buy on eBay US at ≤ $487/unit, capital ≈ $887), Thailand-readiness gate (ready=true, 0 unknowns, 0 blockers), the real 7-step playbook, and a PROJECTED money/time schedule (d0 -$887 → d20 +$1,640 → d21 reinvestable $2,527). stage=not_started, schedule.anchored=false — the honest current state.
what_is_proven.driven_after: Ticking playbook step 1 on production (POST /progress step=1 done=true) drove the guide live: stage advanced not_started -> PURCHASED via reconciliation (the step->stage map, WITHOUT touching the chat lifecycle state), the schedule ANCHORED (started=true, day=0, milestones flipped planned -> today/upcoming), the single next step advanced to 'Route the goods and mark in-transit', is_next moved to step 2, progress 1/7 (14%).
what_is_proven.honesty_boundary: schedule.basis='projected'; the note states 'done' means a milestone's projected day has passed, not that cash was received. PLAN progress + PROJECTED money only; realised cash is the next milestone (Outcome learning).

correctness_fix_found_while_live_proving.symptom: After unticking the only done step, the deal still read started=true / schedule.anchored=true (day 0) while stage=not_started and 0 steps done — an inconsistent state.
correctness_fix_found_while_live_proving.cause: deal_started_ts derived from MIN(ts) over mission_progress WITHOUT a done=1 filter, so a touched-then-unticked step still anchored the schedule.
correctness_fix_found_while_live_proving.fix: deal_started_ts now counts only done=1 check-offs (plus real lifecycle transitions). Unticking the last done step un-starts the deal. Shipped in v1.13.1 with a regression test (test_deal_started_ts_unticking_last_step_unstarts).
correctness_fix_found_while_live_proving.note: The v1.13.0 production capture 'execution_guide_tick512_opp_0210ef1adc.json' (before) and 'execution_guide_tick512_driven_after.json' (after tick) are both valid; the fix affects only the untick-restore edge and lands in v1.13.1.

restoration: Step 1 was unticked after the capture (POST /progress step=1 done=false) — done_steps returned to []. On v1.13.1 redeploy the deal reads fully not-started again.
